# Zubair Idris Aweda

> Full-stack software engineer based in Derby, UK, with 3+ years shipping production systems in FinTech (PHP/Laravel, Node.js, Vue.js, TypeScript) and a First Class BSc (Hons) in Computer Science from the University of Wolverhampton (July 2026, 90.44% average). Technical author with 443K+ readers on freeCodeCamp, former IBM Z Student Ambassador (Superstar tier), and conference speaker. Open to engineering roles, graduate mainframe roles, and MS/PhD research in robotics, human-robot interaction, AI systems and distributed systems.

Contact: zubairidrisaweda@gmail.com · GitHub: https://github.com/Zubs · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zubairidrisaweda/

Availability: remote (global), hybrid or on-site in the UK, and open to relocation. Preferred focus is backend, or full-stack with a strong backend lean.

- Stax Payments, Mid-Senior Full-Stack Engineer (PHP), Jun 2022 – Oct 2023: Laravel microservices for high-volume payments at 99.9% uptime; API documentation that cut onboarding time by about 40%
- freeCodeCamp, Technical Author and Open Source Contributor, 2021 – present: 15+ articles, 443K+ views, Top Open Source Contributor 2021–2024
- AYU Digital, Software Engineer (contract), Jan – May 2022: Omnichannel notifications (Mailgun, Firebase, Twilio), Twilio verification, PCI-compliant Stripe payments
- Humongous.io, Software Engineer (contract), Mar – Jun 2021: TypeScript migration and automated testing
- CitonHub, Junior Backend Engineer (contract), Nov 2020 – Jan 2021: Laravel and Vue.js modernisation

## Featured projects

- [JCLcheck](https://jclcheck.xyz): Live JCL validation SaaS with a hand-written lexer, parser, AST and rule engine, a 3270-style workbench and an npm CLI with SARIF output ([source](https://github.com/Zubs/jclcheck), [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/jclcheck))
- [OWASP SecBank](https://github.com/Zubs/owasp-sec-bank): Dissertation artefact; one banking app built twice, vulnerable and hardened (Vue 3, Express 5, PostgreSQL)
- Miteno: WhatsApp-ordering storefront for a UK clothing brand, built spec-first with an AI coding agent
- [IslamicHub](https://islamichub.xyz/): Open-source Islamic education platform with Zakat, prayer times and inheritance calculators
- [Kueri](https://kueriapp.netlify.app/): AI-native desktop database client (Electron, Vue 3, Gemini), in progress
- [FootballSite](https://github.com/Zubs/footballSite): Laravel football match tracker with live API sync, graded 100/100
- [ColabDev](https://github.com/Zubs/ColabDev): University open day app built by a team of eight; led the development team; highest mark of the year (96)
- [ScholarSearch](https://github.com/Zubs/scholar-search): Academic search engine over arXiv (FastAPI, Elasticsearch, Vue 3)
- ACO Agent: Unity agent using hand-written Ant Colony Optimisation route planning, plus a Gemini assistant and MobileNet image classification (6CS014 Complex Systems)
- Robot Navigation: Line following, maze solving and behaviour-tree obstacle avoidance for simulated robots in CoppeliaSim (Python)
- Parallel Computing in C & CUDA: pthreads, OpenMP and CUDA coursework including GPU Sobel edge detection and a GPU password cracker (6CS005 High Performance Computing, 100%)
- [toRoman](https://github.com/Zubs/toRoman): Zero-dependency TypeScript Roman numeral library on npm ([playground](https://zubs.github.io/packages/toroman/))

The [Projects page](https://zubs.github.io/projects.html) has the full list, including smaller experiments.
